card.name: Punctuation just before all-caps headings
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a linking word right before a run of ALL-CAPS text, such as a numbered step or a boxed WARNING title. The next word is expected to be in capitals.

modes.label: Number or colon before caps
modes.description: A period, zero or colon after a step number or the word WARNING, followed by a capitalized heading.

modes.label: Linking word inside caps warning
modes.description: A word like and or of in the middle of an all-caps warning line.
modes.example: WARNING: RENAL FAILURE, HEPATIC FAILURE,<< and>> GASTROINTESTINAL HEM

modes.label: Sentence end before caps
modes.description: A period or bracket that ends text just before a capitalized heading or sentence.
